title: A tokenizer with spans
description:
Split arithmetic into tokens without making substrings, using `ReadOnlySpan<char>`.

```
"12 + 3.5*(x - 4)"
Number 12 | Plus | Number 3.5 | Star | LParen | Name x | Minus | Number 4 | RParen
```
hints: Inside a loop over `i`, skip spaces; on a digit, move `i` forward while it is a digit or `.`, then parse `text[start..i]` (lesson 7.04).
`ReadOnlySpan<char>` cannot be stored in a field or used across an `await`, which is why `Tokenize` returns a list of plain tokens.
requirements: `List<Token> Tokenize(ReadOnlySpan<char> text)` walks the span with an index.
`record struct Token(TokenKind Kind, double Number = 0, string? Name = null)`; names are the only strings created.
An unexpected character throws `FormatException` with its position.
stretch: Benchmark it against a version that uses `Substring` with `Stopwatch` over 100,000 runs.
